sloka: तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा रामो रमयतां वरः ।वानरेन्द्रमथोवाचं मैत्रं तस्यानुचिन्तयन् ।। ७.१०८.२५ ॥
transliteration: tasya tadvacanaṁ śrutvā rāmo ramayatāṁ varaḥ ।vānarendramathovācaṁ maitraṁ tasyānucintayan ।। 7.108.25 ॥

translations.english: Having heard his words, Rama, the best among those who delight, then spoke to the king of monkeys, reflecting upon their friendship.
